correctness.rationale: Exact basis amplitudes reduce the overlap to a characteristic function of the induced-edge count; averaging its modulus square against the common Gaussian gives a finite identity. A centered Bernoulli Hoeffding expansion yields variance (S+m)/8 for independent configuration differences. The degree regularity conditions imply Lindeberg CLT for the linear component and L² negligibility of the quadratic component, giving the universal Gaussian fidelity profile. For K_n, the induced edge count is binomial choose-two and D=K-L has exact Vandermonde distribution; uniform local central binomial approximation and subgaussian tail splitting give the postcritical Jacobi theta crossover, including its three regimes. For stars, the hub Bernoulli times leaf-count representation gives the displayed non-Gaussian limit. The actual packaged checker reproduces independent finite small-graph identities and numerical asymptotic illustrations; none is substituted for infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The physical correlated Gaussian edge-phase error is explicitly prior to Szymański--Vandré--Gühne and is not claimed as new. The original mathematical statement is the exact all-graph fidelity identity followed by the degree-norm universal limit, the complete-graph lattice theta crossover across three postcritical scales, and the sharply different local-Clifford-equivalent star response. The nearest full-state graph fidelity source uses IID Pauli noise, while the same-noise source analyzes only a low-order post-measurement extraction response. The 2026 weighted-graph metrology paper treats independent Gaussian edge weights and different observables. No inspected primary result or retrieved literature-index statement implies this entire theorem.
residual_risks: A differently indexed one-axis-twisting Loschmidt-echo or random-phase coherent-control article might contain an equivalent Jacobi-theta scaling after translating variables.

The mathematical limit follows from classical triangular-array and local central-binomial methods; only their complete source-specific correlated-graph-state fidelity application and topology comparison are claimed original.
The common-angle Gaussian model is already published; neither the noise mechanism itself nor local-Clifford equivalence is claimed as a new physical discovery.
The relative theta crossover requires n^{3/2}σ_n→∞ and cannot be extrapolated to the critical n^{-3/2} window.

value.rationale: A recent graph-state fidelity paper specifically motivates correlated noise and finds topology-dependent robustness under IID Pauli noise. Another primary paper already establishes common-mode Gaussian edge drift but does not quantify the resulting unmeasured fidelity sensitivity of arbitrary graphs. The theorem supplies the graph-invariant precision scale √Σdegree², resolves two additional discrete crossovers for the highly relevant fully connected gate architecture, and constructs a stark contrast between star and complete preparation circuits even though their noiseless states are local-Clifford equivalent. This is a motivated structural precision boundary, not a numerical exercise or a renamed generic CLT; its exact scope excludes unsupported hardware-level claims.
